info.name: Validic Inform Devices Observations & Data API

params.name: org_id
params.description: The Validic organization identifier.

params.name: uid
params.description: The user identifier (customer-supplied uid or Validic id).

params.name: start_date
params.description: Start of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Maximum range is 30 days per request.

params.name: end_date
params.description: End of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: source
params.description: Comma-separated list of source (device/app) types to filter by.

params.name: token
params.description: Organization access token.
